faults.stored: municipal or regional body, sourced to a Museums Aotearoa job-board listing
faults.page says: The listing is a Council recruitment advertisement hosted on museumsaotearoa.org.nz; it says 'As a part of the Whanganui District Council, Te Whare o Rehua Sarjeant Gallery contributes to the Council's vision'. It is not a statute, register entry or the gallery's own governance page, and the gallery's own About page (sarjeant.org.nz/about) does not state its legal form.

History page: in 1987 two individuals acquired the house and 'create the Foundation Casa de los Tres Mundos'. Confidencial (12 Feb 2026): the foundation was outlawed by the Executive on 19 Aug 2024 and the building was seized by the State. No cited page shows a form in force today; a donor-founded foundation would in any case be 'private foundation', not 'private nonprofit'.

About page: G.A.S. Foundation was 'established in 2019 by the eminent British-Nigerian artist Yinka Shonibare' and 'is a non-profit' governed by a board of trustees. Under the brief a foundation set up by a private donor is 'private foundation'; 'private nonprofit' is for a trust or charity with an independent board, and here governance is directed by the Yinka Shonibare Foundation.

corrected.basis: The About Us page says G.A.S. Foundation is a non-profit governed by a board of trustees, with governance and oversight directed by the Yinka Shonibare Foundation.
